title: Frequently Asked Questions & Payments
tagline: Answers to Common Questions on Quality, Payments & Origins

sections.summary: Instant UPI, Cards, Net Banking, and Pay on Delivery supported.
sections.content: Interesting supports 100% secure payments via Instant UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM), all major Credit/Debit Cards, Net Banking, and Pay on Delivery (Cash on Delivery / UPI QR on Delivery) with zero convenience charges.

sections.summary: White Whole 180 grade: largest jumbo cashews with under 180 kernels per pound.
sections.content: W180 stands for 'White Whole 180'—internationally certified as the King of Cashews. There are less than 180 whole kernels per pound (~453g). These are the largest, plumpest, and naturally creamiest cashews harvested in India.

sections.summary: Slow wood-fired dry roasted without commercial palm oil or deep-frying.
sections.content: We avoid commercial deep-frying or palm oil. All our flavoured nuts are slow wood-fired and dry roasted in artisanal batches with Himalayan rock salt and real saffron, preserving natural unsaturated fats and vitamins.

sections.summary: Keep in airtight canisters; store in refrigerator during humid summer for up to 9 months freshness.
sections.content: Our tins feature airtight inner pull-rings and reusable lid caps. Keep tins in a cool, dry place. In humid weather or summer months, storing them in the refrigerator preserves peak crunch and aroma for up to 9 months.
